messages:
Luca (prod): Quick sync: multiple customers (HealthOps, FinLedger) want streaming guarantees for chat + function-calls + structured outputs. They specifically asked for: resume, clear cost model, and how finish reasons map to tool invocations. Need a concise MVP spec.

Jin (eng): High-level: two orthogonal decisions — transport (SSE vs WS) and delta grain (token vs chunk vs JSON-patch). Transport choice impacts proxies & mobile; delta grain impacts client rendering and rehydration for resume.

Rhea (runtime): Runtime constraints: we can emit token deltas cheaply, but bundling tokens into chunks reduces overhead. Resume support will require an opaque resume_token + stable sequence index. For function calls we must ensure caller/deserializer can reassemble structured JSON without ambiguity.

Diego (devex): SDK perspective: prefer maximal consistency. Proposal: a minimal envelope with fields (event_type, seq, data, meta) where data can be "token", "chunk", or "json_patch". Final event_type `stream_end` with finish_reason in {completed, truncated, cancelled_by_client, func_error, system_error}.

Kari (design): UX note: function calls often produce structured JSON that must be streamed as partial JSON fragments. Clients need clear guidance on incremental parsing vs waiting for `stream_end`. Provide examples: inline function streaming and function-as-is (tool) modes.

Luca (prod): Launch gates suggestion: 1) wire format documented + examples for token, chunk, and JSON-patch deltas; 2) SDKs for browser (SSE) and node/native (WS) both parsing the same envelope; 3) resume_token semantics defined (TTL, max-resume-window); 4) metrics and billing prototype.

Jin (eng): Suggested MVP scope to reduce risk: support SSE first for browsers (uses EventSource), and WS for bidirectional clients; delta grain = chunk by default (~16-64 tokens) and token mode behind flag. Resume: opaque token every N chunks (e.g., N=8). Full byte-offset resume postponed to v2.

Rhea (runtime): For function calls we will stream the function body as `json_chunk` events with a stable seq. If a client resumes we re-emit from the next seq. Important: function execution state must be replayable or we mark `func_error` as finish_reason and require client retry.

Diego (devex): Billing model question: bill on tokens emitted vs tokens generated by model? If we bill emitted tokens, clients can intentionally truncate to reduce cost; if we bill generated tokens the server bears cost even if not delivered. Recommend billing on model-side token generation with a free-tier buffer and a per-stream guard for beta. Product input?

Luca (prod): Product preference: bill on generated tokens (predictable for capacity), but show emitted tokens separately in console and warn users about waste on early cancels. For beta, disable billing and show estimates.

Kari (design): Docs: include short patterns: "progressive render" (render tokens as they arrive), "safe-apply" (only apply function result after `stream_end`), and "optimistic-apply" (apply partial JSON but mark as provisional).

Jin (eng): Backpressure and QoS: we need clear server behavior when client can't keep up. Options: stall (buffer up to limit), drop-oldest chunks, or signal client with `throttle` event + Retry-After. Recommend stall up to a bounded buffer Q, then emit `throttle` and set finish_reason=truncated if we must abort. Document observable signals so SDKs can surface them.

Rhea (runtime): Telemetry gate: collect per-stream metrics: model_tokens_generated, tokens_emitted, resume_attempts, resume_success, finish_reason_counts, avg_chunk_latency. These drive SLOs and billing alerts.

Diego (devex): SDK checklist: Event envelope parser, resume-token handler (opaque), `onPartialJson` helper, example for reconnect/resume flow, and sample retry/backoff heuristics for flaky networks.

Luca (prod): Rollout plan: private beta with HealthOps & FinLedger for 4 weeks -> collect resume and billing signal -> iterate -> GA behind feature flag. Target: beta start 5 weeks if eng can deliver.

Jin (eng): Risks: large proxies (CDNs, corp corp-proxies) may buffer SSE until connection close. Need clear doc page for deployment configs and a fallback plan (WS over TLS or chunked HTTP). Also risk: resume token storage cost at scale if TTL high.

Rhea (runtime): Ops: implement resume token garbage collection and a cheap validation scheme (HMAC-signed token with embedded seq and expiry) to avoid server-side state for short TTLs. That reduces DB pressure.

Kari (design): Legal/compliance note: structured outputs may contain PII in function results. Docs must recommend clients sanitize before logging and provide best-practices for redactable fields.

ci-bot: ci-bot: streaming-mvp branch tests: 12/14 passing, flaky test on reconnect logic.

Diego (devex): Action items: I'll draft sample code blocks for all three delta types and a small README for resume flow.

Jin (eng): I'll implement chunk-mode + resume_token HMAC and the `stream_end` event enum. PR ETA 9 days.

Rhea (runtime): I'll add telemetry counters and implement token signing for resume. ETA 10 days.

Luca (prod): Please each add top-2 unknowns by EOD so I can finalize beta criteria. I'll coordinate comms to customers and legal for the PII docs. :rocket:
